content.json:
# FlashCardSage AI
What the AI models behind FlashCardSage are used for, how well they answer, and what they cost:

- **gpt-5-mini** (Azure AI Foundry) suggests new cards, tags for a card, and new tags, and makes cards from an uploaded document.
- **FLUX.2-pro** (Azure AI Foundry) makes the picture of a card.
- **Azure AI Translator** translates one side of a card into the other, through its dictionary for a single word and its translator for anything else.

Most sections come from Application Insights: each call the API makes to a model is a dependency, and the API request that made it says which feature it was for. A call is **Cancelled** when the user stopped waiting for it (the page moved on, or they typed on), so the browser dropped the request; the model may still have charged for it. Application Insights keeps 30 days of telemetry.

The **Azure metrics** and **Costs** sections come from the Foundry and Translator resources themselves, so they also count calls from outside the app, such as `scripts/Generate-SystemDeckImages.ps1` making the built-in decks' pictures.

content.query:
let features = requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend Feature = case(
    name == 'GET api/card-suggestions', 'Card suggestions',
    name == 'POST api/tag-suggestions', 'Tags for a card',
    name == 'GET api/tag-suggestions/new', 'New tags',
    name == 'POST api/document-scans', 'Document scans',
    name == 'GET api/flashcards/practice/sentences', 'Practice sentences',
    name == 'POST api/flashcards/images/generate', 'Pictures',
    name == 'POST api/translations', 'Translation',
    'Other')
| project operation_ParentId = id, Feature, RequestCode = resultCode, User = user_AuthenticatedId;
let calls = dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange} and type == 'HTTP'
| extend Model = case(
    name has '/chat/completions', 'gpt-5-mini',
    name has '/blackforestlabs/', 'FLUX.2-pro',
    target endswith 'microsofttranslator.com', iff(name has '/dictionary/', 'Translator (dictionary)', 'Translator (translate)'),
    '')
| where isnotempty(Model)
| join kind=leftouter features on operation_ParentId
| extend Feature = iff(isempty(Feature), 'Other', Feature)
| extend Outcome = case(success == true, 'Succeeded', RequestCode == '499', 'Cancelled', resultCode == '429', 'Rate limited', 'Failed');
let tokens = traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange} and isnotempty(customDimensions.PromptTokens)
| extend Prompt = tolong(customDimensions.PromptTokens), Cached = tolong(customDimensions.CachedPromptTokens),
    Completion = tolong(customDimensions.CompletionTokens), Reasoning = tolong(customDimensions.ReasoningTokens),
    FinishReason = tostring(customDimensions.FinishReason)
| join kind=leftouter features on operation_ParentId
| extend Feature = iff(isempty(Feature), 'Other', Feature);
let total = toscalar(calls | summarize sum(itemCount));
let percent = (n: long) { iff(total == 0, '', strcat(' (', round(100.0 * n / total, 1), '%)')) };
let failed = toscalar(calls | where Outcome in ('Failed', 'Rate limited') | summarize sum(itemCount));
let cancelled = toscalar(calls | where Outcome == 'Cancelled' | summarize sum(itemCount));
let answers = toscalar(tokens | count);
let tokenCount = toscalar(tokens | summarize sum((Prompt + Completion) * itemCount));
union
    (print Order = 0, Metric = 'Calls to the models', Value = tostring(total)),
    (print Order = 1, Metric = 'Failed', Value = strcat(failed, percent(failed))),
    (print Order = 2, Metric = 'Cancelled by the user', Value = strcat(cancelled, percent(cancelled))),
    (print Order = 3, Metric = 'Pictures made', Value = tostring(toscalar(calls | where Model == 'FLUX.2-pro' and Outcome == 'Succeeded' | summarize sum(itemCount)))),
    (print Order = 4, Metric = 'gpt-5-mini tokens', Value = iff(answers == 0, 'None logged yet', tostring(tokenCount))),
    (print Order = 5, Metric = 'People who used them', Value = tostring(toscalar(calls | where isnotempty(User) | summarize dcount(User))))
| order by Order asc
| project Metric, Value

content.json: **People who used them** counts the signed-in users whose requests called a model. The smoke tests and load test sign in as a service user, which isn't counted there but whose calls are.

content.json: A **Result code** of 0 means the call got no answer: it timed out, or was cancelled. **Rate limited** (429) means the deployment's quota per minute was used up (`capacity` and `suggestionCapacity` in `infra/modules/foundry.bicep`).

content.json:
## gpt-5-mini tokens
The tokens each answer from gpt-5-mini used, as the API logs them. **Prompt** tokens are what it was sent: the instructions and the user's cards, tags or document. **Cached** prompt tokens are the part it had seen recently, which costs a tenth as much. **Completion** tokens are what it wrote, including its **reasoning**, which isn't shown to the user but is paid for. An answer **Cut short** ran out of completion tokens before it finished, and couldn't be used.

Answers the user had stopped waiting for aren't logged, since the API stops reading them.

content.query:
let features = requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend Feature = case(
    name == 'GET api/card-suggestions', 'Card suggestions',
    name == 'POST api/tag-suggestions', 'Tags for a card',
    name == 'GET api/tag-suggestions/new', 'New tags',
    name == 'POST api/document-scans', 'Document scans',
    name == 'GET api/flashcards/practice/sentences', 'Practice sentences',
    name == 'POST api/flashcards/images/generate', 'Pictures',
    name == 'POST api/translations', 'Translation',
    'Other')
| project operation_ParentId = id, Feature, RequestCode = resultCode, User = user_AuthenticatedId;
let tokens = traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange} and isnotempty(customDimensions.PromptTokens)
| extend Prompt = tolong(customDimensions.PromptTokens), Cached = tolong(customDimensions.CachedPromptTokens),
    Completion = tolong(customDimensions.CompletionTokens), Reasoning = tolong(customDimensions.ReasoningTokens),
    FinishReason = tostring(customDimensions.FinishReason)
| join kind=leftouter features on operation_ParentId
| extend Feature = iff(isempty(Feature), 'Other', Feature);
tokens
| summarize Answers = sum(itemCount), ['Prompt tokens'] = sum(Prompt * itemCount), Cached = sum(Cached * itemCount),
    ['Completion tokens'] = sum(Completion * itemCount), Reasoning = sum(Reasoning * itemCount),
    ['Prompt per answer'] = round(avg(Prompt)), ['Completion per answer'] = round(avg(Completion)),
    ['Cut short'] = sumif(itemCount, FinishReason == 'length')
    by Feature
| order by ['Prompt tokens'] + ['Completion tokens'] desc
content.title: Tokens by feature
content.noDataMessage: No token usage logged in this period.

content.json:
## Caches
Every translation and picture is kept in the database, shared by every user, so the same words are only paid for once. A translation is **From the cache** when anyone has translated the same text before. A picture is when someone has made one of the same words that this user hasn't been shown yet: asking for another picture shows the next one there is, and makes a new one only when there's none left.

content.title: Answers from the cache

content.query:
let step = iff(todatetime('{TimeRange:endISO}') - todatetime('{TimeRange:startISO}') <= 2d, 1h, 1d);
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend Category = tostring(customDimensions.CategoryName)
| extend Series = case(
    Category == 'FlashCardSage.Api.Translation.CachedTranslator' and message startswith 'Found the translation', 'Translations from the cache',
    Category == 'FlashCardSage.Api.Controllers.TranslationsController' and message startswith 'Translated ', 'Translations',
    Category == 'FlashCardSage.Api.Images.CachedImageGenerator' and message startswith 'Found picture', 'Pictures from the cache',
    Category == 'FlashCardSage.Api.Images.CachedImageGenerator' and message startswith 'Kept a new', 'New pictures',
    '')
| where isnotempty(Series)
| make-series Count = sum(itemCount) default = 0
    on timestamp from bin(todatetime('{TimeRange:startISO}'), step) to todatetime('{TimeRange:endISO}') step step by Series
content.title: Translations and pictures
content.noDataMessage: No translations or pictures in this period.

content.json:
## Azure metrics
What the Azure AI Foundry and Translator resources counted, whoever called them. Charts with nothing in them mean the resource wasn't called in this period (or, for Foundry, isn't deployed).

## Costs
What the Azure AI resources cost, from Azure Cost Management, by what's billed (the meter): FLUX.2-pro by the megapixel, and gpt-5-mini by the million input, cached input and output tokens. Translator's free tier (`translatorSku` F0) costs nothing, so it only shows on the paid one. Amounts are actual costs in the billing currency, before any subscription credits. Cost data usually lags usage by 8 to 24 hours, so the most recent day is incomplete. The FlashCardSage Health workbook's **Costs** tab has the whole app's.

content.title: Cost by meter
content.noDataMessage: No AI costs in this period.
